task.population: The peso_lab-weighted complete-case adult distribution in the PNS 2013 laboratory-substudy release, not asserted to be nationally representative: baseline age 20–79, recorded sex 1/2, dictionary-admissible weight/height and final interview SBP/DBP, positive finite laboratory weight. Exclude reported baseline pregnancy; unknown/inapplicable pregnancy retained. No HbA1c, treatment or hypertension restriction. Generated equal-weight rows represent this defined analytical distribution under explicit transport assumptions. Baseline BP timing and unknown released final-reading aggregation must be retained as measurement limitations.

model.population_interpretation: A fixed, assumed law conditional on the task's eligibility and complete-case selection, representing the peso_lab-weighted analytical distribution through equal-weight independent rows. It is not a nationally representative distribution.

covariates.family: Recorded sex followed by sex-specific scaled-beta age, followed by age-and-sex-dependent scaled-beta BMI

bp.conditional_mean_family: Additive linear conditional mean on the requested raw-scale design
bp.innovation_family: Two independent standardized beta innovations, independent of all covariates
bp.innovation_assignment: DBP uses the shared innovation; SBP combines that innovation and an independent SBP-specific innovation with variance-preserving loadings.
bp.measurement_interpretation: Outcomes represent released final interview BP directly, not latent untreated or error-free BP. Residual variation combines unexplained biological, treatment, and measurement variation.
bp.support_rule: Bounded covariate and beta-innovation supports induce bounded raw BP support. No rejection, clipping, rounding, log transformation, or outcome-based selection is applied.

uncertainty.mode: Fixed-parameter illustrative scenario with individual-level Monte Carlo sampling only
uncertainty.source_coefficient_se_usage: Retained in provenance, not used as individual dispersion or as a target-population uncertainty distribution
uncertainty.transport_uncertainty: Unquantified; no estimated confidence or credible interval is claimed
